description: Return curated Examova public-preview practice questions for a certification, optionally filtered by module or keyword. Use it to quiz the user: show the stem and options, let them answer, then reveal correctLabel. Returns the question, options and correct answer letter; full explanations and the complete question bank need an Examova account.

certification.description: Certification slug, code or name, e.g. "pmp", "cips-l4", "prince2-foundation", "business-english". Call list_certifications for the live list.

keyword.description: Optional topic keyword to filter, e.g. "negotiation" or "risk"

name: search_practice_questions
title: Search Practice Questions
